purpose: Join the native cluster, reactor join, and supported-service evidence without promoting any exported meaning beyond its distinct causal proof. The ratified authority defines every required runtime consumer; absence from the current incomplete runtime is a mandatory integration gap, never grounds to omit or reject the formalized meaning.
consumer_field_law: required_runtime_consumer is derived from the ratified source meaning. persistent_runtime_consumer records only the presently observed implementation. A null current consumer increases the mandatory runtime work; it does not weaken the authority requirement.

rows.required_runtime_consumer: Every contact, interpretation, memory, generated candidate, action, and consequence admission that depends on proto-time or derivation standing.
rows.positive_difference: A contact carries proto-time, parents, and a typed external-input derivation before it may participate.
rows.material_severance: A self-parent or illegal derivation kind must hold the contact before possibility formation.
rows.neutral_perturbation: A lawful non-self parent reordering must preserve the result.
rows.restoration: Restoring lawful proto-time and derivation must restore participation.
rows.limit: The supported path has not independently severed proto-time or derivation while holding the rest of the contact constant.

rows.required_runtime_consumer: The sealed contact boundary, every downstream proof-tree use, and all later answerability to contact provenance.
rows.positive_difference: A sealed route and direct-contact provenance are required before the M24 participant enters the cut.
rows.material_severance: A mismatched seal holds the contact and prevents history incorporation.
rows.neutral_perturbation: A lawful carrier ordering change preserves incorporation.
rows.restoration: Restoring the exact seal restores incorporation and restart.
rows.limit: The live runtime presently consumes a direct contact leaf; recursive proof-tree provenance has native representation but no runtime arm using a nontrivial lawful tree.

rows.limit: The complete proposal/candidate/authority/durable/discharge standing family is not yet represented and consumed through this assistant path.

conclusion: The first cluster is joined to the supported assistant, but only M24-E05 and M260-E05 presently satisfy the complete row-level causal promotion law. All twenty remain mandatory authority inheritance. The other eighteen retain useful native/runtime progress and explicit required consumers; their missing current consumers expand the runtime work rather than diminishing the formalizations. None is laundered into completion by neighboring evidence.
